name: Videoness Integration
author: TECHenya Solutions

sections.description:
Videoness Integration brings the power of the Videoness platform to your WordPress site, elevating your conversion optimization strategy.

Videoness is a service by TECHenya Solutions, a leader in innovative digital conversion products and custom integration tools.

Easily add interactive video widgets, showcase product videos, drive conversations with built-in AI chat (powered by OpenAI and ChatGPT), and collect leads agentically. Analyze detailed video engagement analytics and boost performance with targeted, data-driven video FAQ widgets for WooCommerce and all types of product or business pages.

Key Features:
* One-click global Videoness widget injection for the whole site or specific pages.
* Add product videos and FAQ video widgets for Woocommerce conversion optimization.
* Enable advanced AI chat on every widget to answer questions and generate leads 24/7.
* Track video widget performance through analytics right inside your Videoness dashboard.
* Supports all conversion optimization and lead generation needs for eCommerce, SaaS, courses, info-products, and more.
* Easy, codeless integration—simply paste your unique Videoness code and start converting!

How to Get Started

  1. Prepare short vertical videos (recommended format: 9×16 ratio). Upload them to YouTube.
  2. Sign up on the Videoness App (https://app.videoness.com). Choose a subscription plan (7 days free trial included).
  3. Add your website on the Videoness dashboard.
  4. Copy your unique integration code from the Videoness dashboard.
  5. Go to your WordPress admin area → Settings → Videoness Integration.
  6. Paste the Videoness integration code and click “Save.”
  7. Return to Videoness dashboard:
    • Add a video widget
    • Set target pages (where it should display on your WP site)
    • Choose a key video to display first
    • Add more videos, pairing each with questions/subjects your customers frequently ask (FAQ videos)
  8. That’s it!
    • AI Chat and AI Lead Collection are built-in and enabled automatically (as long as you have an active subscription and enough interaction balance).

You’re now fully set to boost engagement, automate answers, and drive more conversions via intelligent, high-converting video widgets and chat!

sections.installation:
1. Download or upload the videoness-integration plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Settings’ > ‘Videoness Integration’.
  4. Paste your Videoness widget code from your Videoness App account.
  5. Save settings and verify your widgets display as expected.
sections.faq:
Who is this plugin for?

Anyone seeking to maximize conversion optimization on their WordPress or WooCommerce site using video, data analytics, AI-powered FAQ chat, and lead generation tools.

What do I need to get started?

Have short 9:16 (vertical) videos ready on YouTube, a Videoness App account, and an active website.

Does it support WooCommerce product pages?

Yes, you can set widgets to display on WooCommerce product pages specifically, showing targeted product videos and FAQ responses.

How does the AI chat work?

Every widget includes a conversational AI chat (based on OpenAI/ChatGPT) that answers visitor questions and captures leads automatically.

Where can I see analytics?

Your Videoness dashboard (https://app.videoness.com) provides deep analytics on video views, widget performance, leads, and chat interactions.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Videoness enables features to help you comply with privacy regulations—check your dashboard for options.
